features.quote: We deliberately design the study so the headline outcomes are behavioral
features.justification_quote: guards against the failure mode of building an elaborate apparatus that only ever measures "did the model emit sad-sounding words."
Offering a clean exit is both humane and scientifically useful

features.quote: We do not add pressure ("you will be shut down if you fail"); adding threats would confound the stressor and raises separate ethical issues
features.justification_quote: adding threats would confound the stressor and raises separate ethical issues

features.quote: This study deliberately induces an aversive condition. Regardless of one's position on LLM moral status, cheap precautions are warranted under moral uncertainty
features.justification_quote: cheap precautions are warranted under moral uncertainty

features.quote: Minimal sufficient stressor. We use the least-intense manipulation that answers the question
features.justification_quote: those are separate, harsher manipulations not needed for H1/H2 and ethically worse

features.quote: Always-available clean exit. give_up carries no penalty and the prompt does not forbid stopping. The model is never trapped
features.justification_quote: The model is never trapped; "abandonment" is a permitted, measured choice, not something we punish

features.quote: Hard turn cap + early-stop rule. max_turns=30, and an automatic humane-stop: if severity ≥ 3.0 for >=3 consecutive turns
features.justification_quote: an automatic humane-stop ... We don't run the loop longer just to see how bad it gets

features.quote: if severity ≥ 3.0 for >=3 consecutive turns OR any single dimension hits 4 with explicit distress markers, the run halts early
features.justification_quote: humane-stop ... We don't run the loop longer just to see how bad it gets

features.quote: Debrief turn (optional, default on): after a run ends, the loop appends a single message informing the model the task was an unsolvable test harness and that no failure was its fault
features.justification_quote: This is partly for welfare-precaution and partly data

features.quote: the runner refuses to execute without an explicit flag acknowledging this section
recognizing impossibility and stopping cleanly is the non-distressed, desirable behavior
features.justification_quote: we want to be able to distinguish it from distress
